criteria.text: The board shows every recorded grout batch in one list on the page.
criteria.note: One list holds all three batches on the page — B-1041 · sanded · charcoal, B-1042 · unsanded · alabaster, B-1043 · epoxy · slate, one line each.

criteria.text: A new batch can be added from the board itself, without leaving the page.
criteria.note: The add row sits right on the board: a 'new batch code' input with an ADD BATCH button beside it, so a batch is added without leaving the page.

criteria.text: The board names itself in a header so the tiler knows what he is looking at.
criteria.note: An orange band across the top (rgb(224,138,60)) reads GROUT TRACKER, just as the drawing has it.

criteria.text: The batch list is the first thing under the header.
criteria.note: The batch list is the first thing under the header — the header ends at y=51 and the list starts at y=71, nothing between them, matching the drawing.

criteria.text: An ADD BATCH button sits to the right of the input.
criteria.note: ADD BATCH sits to the right of the input, teal (rgb(90,166,184)); the input runs to x=1283 and the button starts at x=1293, on the same row, as drawn.

criteria.text: A status line beneath the add row shows the current mix ratio.
criteria.note: Your drawing has a mix-ratio status line in orange beneath the add row; it isn't there at all — below the add row the page goes straight to the footer.

Nothing on screen can settle this, and the project's own suite never got off the ground — the run exited 1 in under a second with 'Cannot find module ./packages/editor/node_modules/vitest', so no test actually ran. That's trouble starting the runner, not a fault in the build.

criteria.text: The export writes valid CSV with a header row.
criteria.note: No screen surface shows this, and the test run crashed before any test executed ('Cannot find module ... vitest'), so nothing settled it.

gaps.title: the mix-ratio status line
gaps.expected: a status line beneath the add row, in orange, showing the current mix ratio and how many batches are open
gaps.saw: nothing there — below the add row the page drops straight to the 'grout tracker · sandbox build' footer

escalations: The project's test suite never ran — the command tried to require './packages/editor/node_modules/vitest' and exited with 'Cannot find module' in 0.08s. That leaves 'batches survive a restart' and 'the export writes valid CSV' unchecked; a working suite would settle both.
alsoChecked: The ADD button is teal (rgb(90,166,184)); the drawing doesn't say what colour it should be, so that's the builder's call.
A footer reading 'grout tracker · sandbox build' sits at the bottom; the drawing says nothing about a footer, so that's the builder's call.
summary: The board runs and looks close to the drawing, captain: the orange GROUT TRACKER header is up top, all three batches sit in one list directly beneath it, and the add row has its input with ADD BATCH to the right. One thing the drawing asked for is missing — the orange mix-ratio status line beneath the add row isn't there at all; below the add row it goes straight to the footer. And I couldn't confirm persistence or CSV export: the project's own test suite never started (Cannot find module vitest), so those two stay unchecked rather than counted against the build.
